programme.title: Scream 2

programme.title: Little Man

programme.title: Haywire

programme.title: Furie

programme.title: Blind Date

programme.title: Ghost

programme.title: Ronin

programme.title: Shooter

programme.title: Dreamgirls

programme.title: The Fighting Temptations
programme.desc: To collect his aunt's inheritance, an unemployed man (Cuba Gooding Jr.) must form a gospel choir and lead it to success.

programme.title: Selma

programme.title: Geronimo: An American Legend

programme.title: The Magnificent Seven (1960)

programme.title: Return Of The Seven

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows

programme.title: Lara Croft: Tomb Raider

programme.title: Lara Croft Tomb Raider: Cradle of Life

programme.title: Saving Private Ryan

programme.title: Hot in Cleveland
programme.desc: Waiting to use the women's restroom at a Browns game, Melanie, Victoria and Joy recount to Elka how they all originally met on a Beverly Hill's hotel rooftop in the 80s.

programme.title: Hot in Cleveland

programme.title: Hot in Cleveland
programme.desc: Victoria's daughter Emmy and Melanie's son Will break the news that they're engaged to each other, and Joy dates a 22-year-old who literally can't see her actual age.

programme.title: Hot in Cleveland
programme.desc: When "All My Children" is canceled, Susan Lucci shows up at the house hoping that Victoria will be sympathetic, only for Victoria to be suspicious of her true intentions.

programme.title: Hot in Cleveland
programme.desc: To make Johnny jealous, Victoria throws herself at his alcoholic ex-bandmate, while Melanie makes out with a man whom she thinks is the lead singer of the band Bread.

programme.title: Hot in Cleveland
programme.desc: As Victoria reunites with her first ex-husband, Melanie goes after her high school crush, Joy tries to meet up with her ex-fiancee Kyle, and Elka gets back together with Max.
